bounded_slice.tested_scope: Static exact-commit reachability audit of two principal production backend-reuse families around AgentCliBackend.set_usage_context and run_exec/log-path selection at Argus commit 2894b434affaff3a28c1fbbcd5c39f2e7a832236. This slice tests whether those traced families can reuse one backend first without project context and later with project context. It does not claim repository-wide caller exhaustiveness or prove the transition impossible for every direct or other caller.

upstream.provenance: All accepted source observations were read from the exact immutable commit above; the recursive tree was resolved by the exact tree SHA above. No branch-head source observation is used as evidence for this slice.

observations: AgentCliBackend.set_usage_context stores the current usage project root and mission id on the backend; AgentIO path selection later reads that current context, so risk depends on caller lifecycle ordering rather than a project root permanently fixed at backend construction.

In the AgentRuntime construction family, a stable runtime-level usage project root is derived when the runtime is constructed and _set_usage_context propagates that same project root while mission id changes. Within one traced AgentRuntime instance, this supplies an invariant project-root value rather than a no-project to project transition.

In the cached subagent backend family, backend reuse exists, but the production invocation path derives a project-specific usage root from cwd and calls set_usage_context before execution. In the traced path, reuse is therefore refreshed to project context before run_exec rather than first executing in the legacy no-project branch and later transitioning to project context.

The lower-level backend fallback that can select <working_dir>/.argus/events.jsonl when project context is absent remains present. This slice therefore narrows the previously demonstrated helper/API counterexample but does not close reachability for untraced direct or other callers.
bounded_slice.acceptance_effect: The prior post-marker legacy-append counterexample remains valid at the helper/API composition boundary, but its production reachability is narrowed: neither of the two traced principal backend-reuse families exhibits the hazardous no-project to project transition. The remaining child is to exhaust exact-commit production set_usage_context/run_exec callers that could execute before context is set or reuse a backend across distinct roots. Candidate remains unresolved until that child is closed or a reachable caller is reproduced.
